recognize_zh: 這張血片紅血球形態非常雜：大量無中央淡染的小而深染球形紅血球（spherocytes），夾雜卵圓形／橢圓形紅血球、三角形或頭盔狀破碎紅血球（schistocytes）、帶尾巴的淚滴細胞（dacrocytes），以及少數偏大偏藍的多染性紅血球；多種異形並存即為明顯的異形紅血球症（poikilocytosis）。
features: Numerous small dense spherocytes lacking central pallor
Ovalocytes and elongated elliptical red cells, some large
Fragmented red cells including triangular and helmet-shaped schistocytes and microspherocytic fragments
Occasional teardrop cells (dacrocytes) with tapered tails
A few larger, slightly bluish polychromatophilic red cells; platelets present; stain with a blue-grey cast
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous spherocytes and microspherocytes, together with ovalocytes, elliptocytes, schistocytes including helmet and triangular forms, and occasional dacrocytes. Scattered polychromatophilic red cells indicate a reticulocyte response, and platelets are present. No leukocytes are included in this field. These findings indicate a hemolytic process with red cell fragmentation and are nonspecific in etiology; the proposed interpretation of myelodysplasia with secondary immune hemolysis requires DAT, hemolysis markers, bone marrow examination and, in a young child, exclusion of inherited membrane disorders.

ddx.vs: In a young child, marked microspherocytes, fragments and elliptocytes with a very low MCV suggest HPP, confirmed by thermal sensitivity, EMA binding or spectrin gene testing with a negative DAT.
HS shows spherocytes with polychromasia but few schistocytes, elliptocytes or teardrop cells, a negative DAT and a positive family history or reduced EMA binding.
TMA shows abundant schistocytes with thrombocytopenia, renal or neurologic involvement and, in TTP, severely reduced ADAMTS13, whereas platelets here are not obviously reduced.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT (IgG) but lacks prominent fragmentation, elliptocytes and dacrocytes.
